reports.title: KOSMOS ENERGY ANNOUNCES THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS

guidance.heading: Fourth Quarter 2026 Guidance
section:
Production(1,2,3) | 60,000 - 64,000 boe per day
Opex | $18.00 - $20.00 per boe
DD&A | $17.50 - $19.50 per boe
G&A(~61% cash) | $10-$15 million
Exploration Expense(4) | ~$5 million
Net Interest Expense | $50 - $55 million
Tax | $11.00 - $15.00 per boe
Capital Expenditure | $50 - $75 million
Note: Ghana / Mauritania & Senegal revenue calculated by number of cargos. Guidance excludes Equatorial Guinea from June 17, 2026 following the sale of the assets.
(1)4Q 2026 net cargo forecast – Ghana: 3 cargos. Average cargo sizes 950,000 barrels of oil.
(2)4Q 2026 gross LNG cargo forecast - Mauritania & Senegal: 8-9 cargos. Average cargo size ~170,000 m3 with Kosmos NRI of ~24%. Kosmos expects 0.4 net condensate cargos in 4Q 2026
(3)Gulf of America Production: 4Q 2026 forecast 10,000 - 11,500 boe per day. Oil/Gas/NGL split for 2026: ~83%/~10%/~7%.
